title: Aufgabenball: nachweisbarer Durchlauf

budget.comment: No more paid runs until ChatGPT role identities are verified; existing API balance is not readable via GitHub.

goal: Show one bounded responsibility handoff with a visible ball, an audit event and a recovered state after reload, on an existing non-public prototype.
acceptance: Each contribution must include technical role ID and invocation evidence or be marked NOT_EXECUTED.
Ball ownership is explicit and matches the event log.
No simulated answer may be recorded as a live agent response.
No implementation before approved scope and role readiness.
No merge or public release without Peter.
stop_conditions: After one failed handoff without automatic retries
authorization: Preparation and offline verification only; no implementation or API dispatch authorized.
